name: ceramics-api

dependencies.name: ceramics-db
dependencies.description: Stores products, inventory levels, carts, orders, and order status history.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the caller's Thunder-issued token and resolves the shopper vs. store-admin role for protected endpoints.

dependencies.name: payment-provider
dependencies.description: Hosted third-party card-payment checkout used to process order payments; vendor not yet pinned.

description: The store's backend API: product catalog CRUD and browsing, cart, checkout orchestration (flat-rate shipping, hosted card payment), order creation and status tracking, inventory management, and role-gated admin operations. Owns all persistence and the payment integration; the webapp never touches the database or the payment provider directly.
